table.name: TLGNC_CURRENCY_EXCH_RATE
table.description: Currency exchange rates. All exchange rates are always expressed relatively to ONE single base currency, valid for the whole installation. For Switzerland and Europe this is EUR. In the future, for an additional/independent installation - for example North/South America - USD may be chosen as base currency. Conversions from CUR1 to CUR2 are always performed via this base currency.

column.name: CURRENCY_CD
column.description: The currency for which the exchange rate towards the base currency (EUR for the current release) is defined.

column.name: VALID_FROM_DAT
column.description: Validity start date of the exchange rate. The valid_to_date is implicitely defined by the next record for the same currency_cd, or infinite in case of the last record. Gaps in the validity of exchange rates are therefore impossible by design.

column.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
column.description: Exchange rate of base currency (EUR) to currency_cd. Examples from 25.08.2009: EUR/CHF = 1.5178, EUR/USD = 1.4334, EUR/GBP = 0.8752, EUR/HUF = 266.3500. If the rate is modified for the current or a past period, already existing orders/order_items are NOT updated, as the exchange rate is frozen for each order_item, see tlgnc_order_item.delivery_dat_exchange_rate. It is therefore recommended to not edit an exchange rate, but rather add a new record, with a valid_from_dat in the future.
